Reviews: This was our fourth visit to Sri Lanka and the sixth occasion that we have stayed at Reef Villa.  Given the pandemic that has effected the world over the last two years, we were delighted to find that the owners had been able to retain the services of many of the established staff with the General Manager, Chef, Head waiter, Head of Housekeeping all being familiar faces and helped make our holiday very enjoyable.   The Island generally was still taking precautions against the virus and the controls that the Hotel exercised made us feel very safe and enabled us to stay relaxed during our stay.   All our requirements were attended to without any fuss, including the search for a battery charger, which we had inadvertently left at home! There is a wide selection of food availablethroughout the day which is all prepared and cooked fresh, making the most of the exceptional quality of produce available on the island.    We spoke to the chef and he was able to prepare our food just as we requested.   The service throughout our stay was exceptional,  we are so pleased that we had decided to return and are already planning another trip to Sri Lanka in a couple of years time and undoubtedly we will return to the Reef. If you are seeking a relaxing location with excellent service and quality produce, we can throughly recommend a stay at the Reef.  Considering the anxiety that has been experienced over the last two years, we had been concerned at how the pandemic might have effected Reef Villa, but we need not have worried.  The quality remains and will improve further as the Island reopens. An excellent location and most enjoyable stayâ€¦

Reviews: A lot of complimentary things have been said about this stunning Spa which to the most part I entirely agree.  We have just returned from a tour of the Island and have stayed at some amazing places so feel qualified to point out some areas that fellow travellers should be aware of before staying here. The menu was not the most imaginative and if you were staying for any length of time you would be hard pressed to find a different choice each day. A lot of the dishes relied on avocado which we were told was out of season, further restricting choice, but amazingly the next day it was back in season. The railway line runs just behind the Hotel, so of you are a light sleeper, the trains hooting will keep you awake from about 6am every morning. The beach is stunning but not userâ€¦

Reviews: This was a three night stay after a touring trip around Sri Lanka. It was the perfect place to unwind after bouncing for several days along potholed roads around this beautirul island. It only has 7 rooms, and the service is very warm and personal. The public areas are really beautiful, and the rooms large and full of character. Brendan, the owner, made us very welcome, and is keen to hear any comments or suggestions you may have. Just a couple of minor criticisms: breakfast has a very limited menu - Sri Lankan curry style, or bacon and eggs style. But Brendan is going to introduce waffles, which will give a bit more choice. The other minor gripe is that a 2% charge was put on our bill for payment by card. We were not forewarned, and no other hotel we stayed at did this.â€¦
reference: Food: breakfast had limited menu such as srilankan curry style or bacon and eggs,but waffel were said to be introduced soon

Reviews: My friends and I arrived at the Reef Villa & Spa after a gruelling drive from Colombo Airport.  We'd flown overnight, and were exhausted, starving and didn't really know what to expect.  As soon as we arrived however, we were immediately thrilled to be there.  Not only is it a beautiful boutique hotel, but everything from the service, to the rooms and the friendly attitude of the staff made it feel very homely and comfortable.
